reviews.text: Profesor Yamasato was great and very patient. It will definitely be a challenging class if you have no previous music experience but as someone who only knew up to the major and minor scales, it was the perfect amount of challenge without being overwhelmingly hard. He is very patient so if you have any questions go to office hours, he starts explaining at the level you are at even if you are weeks behind in understanding or way ahead of the class.
